chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudhayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, who said:

"Whoever says in the morning before the sun rises and in the evening before the sun sets: 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger, and that the religion is as He prescribed, and Islam is as He described, and the statement is as He conveyed, and the Book is as He revealed, and that Allah is the manifest Truth,' and mentions Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with good, and greets Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with peace, Allah will open for him the eight gates of Paradise, and it will be said to him: Enter from whichever of its gates you wish, and the sins of that day will be erased from him."

key_terms.الْحَقّ الْمُبِين: the manifest Truth, a Quranic attribute of Allah
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَة أَبْوَاب الْجَنَّة: the eight gates of Paradise, a well-known eschatological concept
key_terms.وَحْدَه لَا شَرِيك لَه: alone without partner, the core monotheistic declaration of tawhid

ai.seo_question: What morning and evening recitation opens all eight gates of Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches a comprehensive morning and evening declaration of faith that encompasses testimony to God's oneness, Muhammad's prophethood, the authenticity of the religion, Islam, divine speech, and the revealed Book, followed by sending blessings upon the Prophet and his family. The reward for this practice is the opening of all eight gates of Paradise and the forgiveness of that day's sins. This teaching was transmitted through a strong Qummi chain and reflects the Shia emphasis on including the Prophet's family in daily devotional practice.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Waleed reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudhail, from Abu al-Sabah al-Kanani, that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as):

"Whoever says in the morning before the sun rises [and in the evening before the sun sets]: 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without any partners, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger, and that the religion is as He has prescribed, and Islam is as He has described, and the statement is as He has conveyed, and the Book is as He has revealed, and that Allah is the manifest truth,' and mentions Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with good, and sends peace upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, Allah will open for him the eight gates of Paradise, and it will be said to him: Enter from whichever gate you wish, and his sins for that day will be erased."
